name: The Chancellor
source:
The Chancellor has served the royal family ever since he learned how to control his powers. His ability to control the minds of others made him indispensable to the royal family… until [url=/c166919]Ravena[/url]’s parents started to question whether he was forcing people to confess. The Chancellor started to resent the King and Queen because of that, ultimately leading to his plot against the royal family.
